import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def task_func(df):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) or df.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input must be a pandas DataFrame with at least one column.")

    result = df.copy()
    last_col = result.columns[-1]

    imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="mean")
    result[[last_col]] = imputer.fit_transform(result[[last_col]])

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    sns.boxplot(y=result[last_col], ax=ax)
    ax.set_title(f"Box Plot of {last_col}")
    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel(last_col)

    return result, ax
